bounded_question: What is the complete HistogramImpl statistics family on node #115: how are the bucket boundaries generated, how are values recorded and merged, how are percentile/average/stddev computed, and what does the full text renderer emit?

re_shipped_from.note: Byte-identical copies; verify.py regenerates every excerpt fresh from the binary and requires byte-equality.

fields_inner.+0x00: min (u64, initialised to the last boundary)

histogram_object.note: The vtable thunks add 8 to `this`, so the implementations take the inner pointer (outer+0x08); the name/min/max accessors take the outer pointer. All field offsets in this packet are inner-relative unless marked outer.

boundaries.statics: 0x6505d20 begin, 0x6505d28 end, 0x6505d30 capacity, 0x6505d38 last boundary (ceiling), 0x6505d40 first boundary
boundaries.initial_cur: 3.0 (2 * 1.5; also the literal at 0x459608 on the fresh-vector path)
boundaries.rounding: a pushed value above 109 is divided by 10 while the pre-division value exceeds 1099 (0x44b), counting a factor of 10 each time, then multiplied back by the factor
boundaries.span_check: 0x28 + 109*8 == 0x390, so the buckets end exactly where the bucket-count field begins
boundaries.grow_helper: 0x5dde8e0 (generic vector grow, cited by contract, not excerpted)

bucket_index_0x606afa0.rule: first index j with BOUNDARIES[j] >= value (std::lower_bound); values at or above the ceiling (last boundary) return count - 1

shared_init_0x606b020.behavior: inner+0x00 (min) = qword at 0x6505d38 (the ceiling); inner+0x08..0x20 (max, count, sum, sumSq) = 0; buckets inner+0x28.. zeroed for bucket_count entries

locked_init_0x606b0c0.behavior: locks the mutex at outer+0x3a0 with pthread_mutex_lock (throws __throw_system_error on failure), calls 0x606b020(outer+8), unlocks

record_0x606b130.behavior: bucket = bucket_index(value) via 0x606afa0 (lea of 0x6505d20); buckets[bucket]++; min = min(min, value); max = max(max, value); count++; sum += value; sumSq += value*value (all wrapping u64)

merge_inner_0x606b1d0.behavior: min = min(dst, src) via lock cmpxchg; max = max(dst, src) via lock cmpxchg; count/sum/sumSq += src via lock add; buckets[i] += src buckets[i] via lock add; skipped entirely when the destination bucket count is 0

merge_wrapper_0x606bdf0.behavior: locks the destination mutex at +0x3a0, calls 0x606b1d0(dst+8, src+8), unlocks

merge_entry_0x606be40.behavior: merges only when the two histograms share a name: fast path when the other's vtable slot 0x38 is 0x606af40; otherwise calls each side's slot-0x38 name accessor and strcmp's the results against 'HistogramImpl' (0x43fa67); a name mismatch returns without merging

percentile_0x606b260.walk: accumulate bucket counts from index 0 until the running total reaches the threshold; past the last bucket returns (double)max
percentile_0x606b260.interpolation: value = lower + ((threshold - prev_cum) / bucket_count) * (upper - lower), where lower = BOUNDARIES[i-1] (0 for i == 0) and upper = BOUNDARIES[i]; an empty bucket returns its lower boundary; the result is clamped to [min, max]
percentile_0x606b260.conversions: u64->double uses the unsigned fixup (shr $1 + or + addsd doubling) wherever a count, sum, bound or bucket value may have the high bit set

median_0x606b500.behavior: loads 50.0 (0x459950) into xmm0 and tail-jumps to 0x606b260

percentile_thunk_0x606b530.signature: double percentile_virtual(outer, double pct) (vtable slot 0x60, RELATIVE at 0x64d2be0)
percentile_thunk_0x606b530.behavior: adds 8 to rdi and tail-jumps to 0x606b260 with the caller's xmm0 percentile

average_0x606b540.behavior: 0.0 when count == 0, else (double)sum / (double)count, with the unsigned fixup on both conversions

stddev_0x606b5d0.behavior: 0.0 when count == 0, else sqrt(max(0, (count*sumSq - sum*sum) / count*count)) in doubles, with the unsigned fixup on count, sum and sumSq

renderer_0x606b6f0.entry: 0x606bc90 (vtable slot 0x30, RELATIVE at 0x64d2bb0; adds 8 to the hist argument, calls here)
lines: Count: %lu Average: %.4f  StdDev: %.2f\n (0x9663a0; count, average via 0x606b540, stddev via 0x606b5d0)
Min: %lu  Median: %.4f  Max: %lu\n (0x964d10; min/max fields when count != 0, literal 0/0 when count == 0; median via 0x606b500)

one row per non-empty bucket: '%c %7lu, %7lu ] %8lu %7.3f%% %7.3f%% ' (0x966d98; '[' + lower 0 for bucket 0, '(' + BOUNDARIES[i-1] otherwise; upper BOUNDARIES[i]; bucket count; bucket percent; cumulative percent), then '#' repeated round(bucket_pct / 5) times, then '\n'
renderer_0x606b6f0.length_guard: before each append, 0x3fffffffffffffff - len(out) < len(chunk) throws __throw_length_error('basic_string::append') (message at 0x4474d2)
renderer_0x606b6f0.cleanup_pad: 0x606b6be..0x606b6e6 disposes the output string and resumes unwinding on exception; reached by the landing pad at 0x606bc81

unknowns: Vtable slot 0x50 (0x5eeb2e0) is not pinned or examined; it sits between the max accessor and the median thunk and its role is unknown.
Vtable slot 0x00 (0x5d89570, the destructor) and slot 0x08 (0x5d8b3b0, the sized delete, pinned by #3362) are not re-examined here.
The statics +0x20 slot holds the first boundary (1), written by the generator exit; no reader of that slot is pinned yet.

The three direct callers of the ToString entry 0x606bc90 (0x5ef0c43, 0x606007d, 0x6198e3a) and the direct callers of the record thunk 0x606b1c0 are cited by FDE only; their owning behaviours are not modelled.
The vector-grow helper 0x5dde8e0 is generic STL machinery shared by five call sites; only its call from the boundary generator is claimed here.
The renderer appends with the std::string SSO/fast paths inline; the slow _M_mutate path (0x606bb78) is noted but the model renders with plain string concatenation.
